## About

I study how where people live, and extreme heat, affect their health, using Brazilian public health data (SUS), maps and spatial analysis. I am a research collaborator at the Laboratory of Geography, Environment and Health (LAGAS/UnB).

## Current projects

::::: {.tabela-inicio}
| Project | Description | Type |
|:--|:--|:--|
| [localdatasus](projects/localdatasus/index.qmd) | Takes Brazilian health data from the municipality down to the neighborhood. | R package |
| [GeoCalor](projects/geocalor/index.qmd) | Heat waves and health, at LAGAS/UnB. | Dashboard |
:::::

More work is listed under [Projects](projects.qmd).
